kept.note: 46.7 moves/s, 0.45 moves/frame, moveGapP95 21 ms; trustedTouch 79/79; deliberate under-driven negative control

why: The negative side of ADR-0145's density-floor calibration, re-measured as a tracked capture instead of a number quoted in prose. This is the campaign's FOUNDING defect reproduced on purpose: the legacy Appium UiAutomator2 browser transport driving Chrome on the physical phone, the same path whose 46.8 moves/s produced android-device-web's fake 10-31% reds. This run measures 46.7 contact moves/s at 0.45 moves per frame (gap p95 21 ms) with paint max 9.6 ms - the app is fine; the sparse input alone reads as 12.86% lost frame time. The density gate refuses it (cadence false), which is the behavior this corpus exists to pin from the bad side; the good side is the 0.96 floor across the healthy corpora. Label caveat: the capture harness stamps ipad-xcuitest/xcuitest: labels regardless of the negotiated platform, so this Android session's directory and mode strings carry an iPad name - a pre-existing harness bug; the artifact's own UA, device serial, and runtime fields are the provenance.
